name: Marketing Automation & Advertising Domain Practices
description: Exhaustive business-domain knowledge pack for marketing automation and digital advertising, covering campaign strategy, audience segmentation, multi-channel email campaigns, creative approvals, media buying, ad serving, impression tracking, and multi-touch attribution.
owner: Global Marketing & Digital Media Operations Office

checklists.name: Marketing Automation & Advertising Audit Checklist
checklists.description: Validation checklist for campaign planning, audience consent, ad creative safety, and attribution tracking.

items.statement: Target audience lists exclude unsubscribed users and enforce consent preferences per privacy laws.
Marketing email templates include valid physical sender addresses and one-click unsubscribe links.
Ad creative assets receive brand compliance and legal review prior to ad network distribution.
Programmatic ad placements filter out non-brand-safe publisher categories and invalid bot traffic.
UTM parameters and conversion tracking pixels accurately measure multi-touch campaign attribution.

reviewGates.name: Marketing Director Campaign Review Gate
reviewGates.statement: The Marketing Director confirms that audience targeting, creative approvals, and media spend budgets satisfy marketing guidelines.
reviewGates.prompt: Does the marketing campaign documentation confirm audience consent compliance and creative approval?
